pullRequests.title: docs: short README and docs sorted into folders
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: docs/readme-cleanup-v2
pullRequests.body:
Before
A long README with setup steps and hand-updated progress tables, and docs in one flat folder with mixed-case names.
After
A short README like Lombyte's: the OpenRAC logo with " decompilation project" under it, a code badge and a note for each version, quick setup, credits and license. Progress comes only from the ByteMatch badges, so the README needs no commit when progress moves. The details moved to docs/, now sorted into docs/build, docs/contributing, docs/game, docs/research,…

commits.headline: fix(compiler): update the tc-mips.c checksum after the docs move
commits.author: bigbeno37
commits.body:
#440 changed the path in a comment that pad_div_erratum_nops.py writes into
gas/config/tc-mips.c (docs/COMPILER-NOTES.md -> docs/build/compiler-notes.md)
without updating the checksum tools/compiler/build.sh checks the patched source
against, so the game compiler no longer built from scratch. The patched file
with the old comment text hashes to the recorded b35ad5aa...; with the new text
it is 3535b59f.... No code changes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
